note: Known problems and their recorded fixes. `detect` and `fix` name functions in scripts/fix/. `verifiedOn` says where the fix was proved; a row not proved on this build says so. A new problem the user meets later becomes a new row. A row with `advice: true` has `fix: null`: every finding it returns is blocked - shown, never applied. A row with `upgrade` brings a registration an older alfred-tools wrote to the way that version passes data, and /alfred-tools:update offers it too.
